source: NHS England, Independent ADHD Taskforce report, part 1 (england.nhs.uk/long-read/report-of-the-independent-adhd-taskforce-part-1)
note: Administrative prevalence means the share of the population with a recorded ADHD diagnosis in health records, as reported by the taskforce. Research prevalence estimates (3-5% of children, 2-3% of adults) apply far more evenly across the sexes.
